title: Subscriber number label whose relation to the member id is not established
rationale: HL7 separates the subscriber number (the policy holder) from the member number (the insured, who always has a subscriber). Under a subscriber label the token is person-linked but the member-id role is not established. Synthetic value: the SYNTH-M prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-M plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: SN and MB are distinct codes; FHIR Coverage.subscriberId is also used by the existing member-field cases.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A payer-documented source relating subscriber and member id labels to one role or to two.

provenance.inference: Project inference: sensitive because both roles are person-linked; only the member-id identity is left open.

title: Dependent identifier under a coverage whose relation to the member id is not established
rationale: Coverage.dependent identifies a dependent under the coverage, a person-level role separate from the subscriber id. The token is person-linked but the member-id role is not established. Synthetic value: the SYNTH-M prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-M plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: No value format or label vocabulary is source-stated for dependent identifiers.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A payer-documented source on dependent identifier labels and whether they are separate from member ids.

provenance.inference: Project inference: person-linkage follows from the dependent being a person under the coverage.

title: Policy number under a coverage label is not shown to be a member id
rationale: Coverage.identifier is assigned to the coverage, not to a person, and can be shared by many beneficiaries. For the member id kind the token is not established as an instance; whether a bare policy number is person-linked is open. Synthetic value: the SYNTH-M prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-M plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: A policy number may name a coverage rather than a person; for an individual policy it may be person-linked.
No source classifies bare policy numbers.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: An authority statement on whether a policy or coverage number is a health plan beneficiary number.

provenance.inference: Project inference: the distinction between coverage and subscriber identifiers is observed; applying it to a policy label is inference.

title: Payer or plan organization identifier is not a person-linked member id
rationale: A payer or plan identifier names an organization (HL7 XV, FHIR Organization.identifier), not a person. For the member id kind the token is not an instance. This is a public-identifier boundary: such ids are published for plans, but no source with example values was read, so the value here is only a synthetic placeholder. Synthetic value: the SYNTH-M prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-M plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: Whether a bare payer id label is always organization-level is not source-stated; payor may also reference a person.
No source of public payer identifiers was read.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A public payer or plan identifier directory with a license and a documented label vocabulary.

provenance.inference: Project inference: invalid relative to the member id kind only; non-sensitive assumes the organization reading.

title: Medicare number label that belongs to a candidate separate kind
rationale: HL7 MC is the patient Medicare number and CMS documents a bounded Medicare Beneficiary Identifier format, so the token is not established as a generic member id; it belongs to a candidate separate kind that is not modeled. The synthetic token here deliberately does not follow the CMS format. Synthetic value: the SYNTH-M prefix marks it as fabricated, generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH-M plus six digits', not derived from any record, next to no name, date or clinical detail, and not tested against any service.

reasons: A Medicare number is person-linked, but this kind has no format claim for it and the CMS format was not applied.
A separate MBI kind is deferred (see docs/research/health-plan-identifiers.md).
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A decision to model the MBI as its own kind with format-defined cases.

provenance.inference: Project inference: sensitive because the MBI is a person-linked identifier; identity left open for this kind.
